bio_paragraphs: I'm a motivated Software Engineer with a passion for building intelligent systems and scalable backend solutions. Currently working as an AI Engineer at Walkover Web Solutions, where I lead backend development for AI-powered products.

My expertise lies in integrating Large Language Models, building RAG pipelines, and developing robust APIs. I've worked extensively with LangChain, HuggingFace, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create intelligent chatbot systems and AI agents that solve real business problems.

Beyond AI, I'm deeply passionate about Data Structures & Algorithms. I've maintained a 365+ day streak on coding platforms and achieved #1 rank among 1,807 students at my university on GeeksForGeeks. I'm also in the top 19% globally on LeetCode.

projects.title: GTWY.ai - Managed AI Platform
projects.description: Built the entire backend for GTWY — an enterprise-grade managed AI platform powering 500K+ active agents and 7M+ automated tasks. Features unified LLM API supporting OpenAI, Anthropic & Gemini with <50ms latency, real-time RAG engine with 98% precision, conversation management, function orchestration, and 2000+ app integrations.

projects.title: AI Screening Tool
projects.description: A flexible interview tool backend leveraging OpenAI GPT-4o API for generating personalized questions. Features real-time communication analysis and a high-performance API framework for secure interview management and audio processing.

projects.title: ViaSocket - Automation Platform
projects.description: Built the backend for ViaSocket, a powerful automation platform that connects apps and automates workflows seamlessly. Engineered robust API integrations, workflow orchestration, and real-time data synchronization for enterprise automation needs.

projects.title: WhatsApp Campaign Automation
projects.description: A web app for running personalised WhatsApp campaigns at scale — upload a CSV of contacts, personalise messages with {{name}} templates, and send in safe paced batches. Supports multiple WhatsApp accounts, campaign scheduling, group invite-link recovery, and per-contact sent tracking so nobody receives the same campaign twice. Licensed product with a guided no-code setup for non-technical users.

projects.title: BW Inventory - Shop Billing
projects.description: A shop inventory and billing app for managing stock and generating bills in real time. Built with TanStack Start and React on a Supabase backend, with CI/CD via GitHub Actions auto-deploying every push to Cloudflare Workers at the edge.

projects.title: Trip Splitter - Expense Tracker
projects.description: A mobile-friendly app to split group and family trip expenses. Keep a reusable people roster, log expenses per trip with flexible sharing, and get an automatic "who pays whom" settlement that minimises the number of transfers. Single Next.js codebase with a Turso (cloud SQLite) database so the whole family sees the same totals from their own phones.
